### Added
- **One release of this chart per target cluster: the target kubeconfig knob, `enabled` for muster and dicebear, one owner per cluster-scoped component, the slice fixtures** (giantswarm/agent-platform#328; bumblebee-plans#46, epic giantswarm/giantswarm#37639). The serving slice (#326) and the runtime slice (#317) are values profiles cluster-manager installs as one `<cluster>-agent-platform` release per target cluster, the slices as toggles in its values — beside the platform's own release on the installation's cluster, or onto a workload cluster that runs no Flux. Three things in the chart stood in the way. New: **`gitops.target.kubeConfig.secretRef`** (`name`, `key`) — when set, every component HelmRelease the loop renders carries `spec.kubeConfig.secretRef` verbatim (the connectivity release included), the field shape the fleet installs every workload-cluster app with, so the installation's helm-controller installs each component into the target from the OCIRepositories in the release namespace, `dependsOn` intact, the connectivity chart's `lookup` guards evaluated against the target; unset, the render is byte-identical to before; refused with the bundled engine on (`agent-platform.validateTarget` — no Flux is installed into a workload cluster or into a cluster that runs one), and no Helm hook renders with it (the kagent storage-version pair would run against the installation's CRDs). **`components.muster.enabled`** and **`components.dicebear.enabled`** (default `true`; the two were force-on) — off renders no release of theirs and the roster tells the connectivity chart, which now drops every reference: muster's `/mcp` HTTPRoute, the `-mcp-egress` policy, the agentgateway data-plane and controller rules, the kagent controller and Substrate rules that select muster's pods (the managers' already read the roster); the avatars host in the portal's CSP. **`components.<name>.ownedCrds`** — a CRD the component installs that already exists and whose Flux labels (`helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/name`, `/namespace`, which helm-controller stamps on every object of a release, `crds/` included) name another HelmRelease fails the render naming the release to remove first (`agent-platform.validateCrdOwners`; agentgateway, kserve-crd, kserve-llmisvc-crd, kagent-crds and muster carry one representative CRD each; skipped with the target knob, where the lookups see the installation; a CRD without the labels is left to Helm as before). `make verify-target` (`tests/verify-target.py`) asserts the offline half: the stamp and the byte-identity of five renders against `origin/main`, the toggles on both charts, the engine guard, the hooks, and the serving- and runtime-shaped toggle sets (`ci/test-slice-serving-values.yaml`, `ci/test-slice-runtime-values.yaml`, `ci/test-target-values.yaml` — the profiles themselves are #326's and #317's) alone, combined (the union; the first slice's documents unchanged when the second is switched on — an in-place upgrade) and targeted, agentgateway off beside the platform's release and on for a workload cluster; the two `lookup` guards are asserted on a cluster (README, "One release per target cluster"). Default render unchanged.
